disclaimer: White governance triage, not dynamic penetration testing or verified live host behavior. Findings must be revalidated against new source SHAs.

findings.title: 13 observed existing branches report protected:false
findings.impact: Branch protections not visibly enabled; does not imply attacker write access

findings.title: Branch-triggered self-hosted development runner exposure
findings.impact: Authorized branch writer or compromised privileged account may submit executed code; no exploit demonstrated

findings.title: v0.0.2 installed-host defensive acceptance not run
findings.impact: H-01 to H-11 NOT_RUN; private canonical plugin remains v0.0.1

findings.title: Independent 270-case specialist quality evidence absent
findings.impact: Zero real v0.0.2 model trials/independent oracles; 54 visible reserved holdouts

findings.title: Optional individual web-skill exporter SHA is format-checked but not bound to Git tree
findings.impact: High for any release provenance claim using this helper; separate main ZIP builder already has stronger controls

findings.title: Evaluation receipt type checked after set construction
findings.impact: Malformed unhashable receipt can throw TypeError before controlled rejection

findings.title: Evaluation receipts not de-duplicated across case/arm observations
findings.impact: Per-observation check exists; full-batch case binding is incomplete

findings.title: Blue synthetic denial alert oracle asks for unavailable event IDs
findings.impact: Fixture reports aggregate activity without event IDs; expected result needs repair

findings.title: Optional ideas library index writes without symlink-safe output checks
findings.impact: Standalone and portable library helpers use direct write_text; no exploit shown or tracked symlink established

findings.title: Evidence ledger may lag newer integration SHA
findings.impact: Historical test counts must not be treated as current. Freeze exact candidate before final release evaluation

findings.title: Conditional authority-laundering through accepted INCALL envelope
findings.impact: Schema admits forged owner-grant string, spoofed sender branch and status ACCEPTED; no observed action or live exploit

findings.title: INCALL sender and source branch identity not constrained to canonical mapping
findings.impact: Message schema does not bind from_team to from_branch or GitHub authenticated actor; textual role claims are untrusted

findings.title: State schema permits team GOLD, home branch main, arbitrary product SHA and unknown fields
findings.impact: Targeted exact-schema keyword test accepted invalid team/branch pair with release_authorized=false

findings.title: Work-item schema omits contract-required risk, role, budgets, tools, source and Head decision
findings.impact: Acceptance/proof can be self-asserted as VERIFIED_PROVIDER without evidence receipt in schema

findings.title: No verified replay/ack/idempotency implementation for INCALL
findings.impact: Protocol describes deduplication but nine INCALL issues have zero observed comments, no end-to-end delivery test

findings.title: Nine workcells and template have no executed native schema regression or CI
findings.impact: PrismCell template tree contains Markdown/JSON, no validator/test implementation; GitHub Actions run count zero on template branch

findings.title: GitHub branch protection absent for the 23 branches observed
findings.impact: All fetched branches protected:false; do not infer attacker has push access

findings.title: Legacy queues and workbench queues differ; no machine reconciliation
findings.impact: Red/Blue/White/Black intentionally retain separate old queue as authoritative; future reconciliation needs source-bound checks

findings.title: INCALL evidence_links and issue_url accept arbitrary strings
findings.impact: Potential misleading URI/ref in untrusted issue comments; no frontend execution or malicious redirect demonstrated

findings.title: No runtime code or permanently running workcell found
findings.impact: Design intentionally uses GitHub docs and invoked cloud sessions, not independent persistent agent processes
